record.NAME: k_pt_zone_max_posn
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum value of the estimated path point. For position outside this range, defined infinitive value is used.

record.NAME: k_pt_min_obj_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum speed of the object to be used to create path

record.NAME: k_pt_overlap_max_match_value
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum match value of the deviation between average value and first value with residuals to group related paths

record.NAME: k_pt_move_max_value
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum value to check if path edges exceed limits after rotation

record.NAME: k_pt_group_max_match_value
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum match value of the difference of path points to group related paths.indicates the minimum required match value of the difference of path points to group related paths

record.NAME: k_pt_group_max_match_value_ad
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum match value of the difference of path points to group related paths for better match

record.NAME: k_pt_group_dir_max_diff_value
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum difference value to distinguish two path

record.NAME: k_pt_group_dir_max_avg_diff_value
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum average difference value to distinguish two path

record.NAME: k_pt_find_max_lat_posn
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum lateral position of the object to be considered as valid

record.NAME: k_pt_find_min_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum speed of the object when object is valid for find match algorithm

record.NAME: k_pt_find_max_long_posn
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum longitudinal position of the object within conflict zone

record.NAME: k_pt_path_change_match_hyst_default
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the confidence value which is applied additive when a path change shall be applied to a given object. This here depicts the default value when two compared paths are equally established.

record.NAME: k_pt_path_change_differing_states_hyst_default
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the confidence value which is applied additive when a path change shall be applied to a given object. This here depicts the default value when two compared paths are equally established, but in different states.

record.NAME: k_pt_path_change_match_hyst_more_established
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the confidence value which is applied additive when a path change shall be applied to a given object. This hysteresis will be used when two paths are compared which are unequally established.

record.NAME: k_pt_path_change_one_grouped_one_mature
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the confidence value which is applied additive when a path change shall be applied to a given object. This hysteresis is used when one path is in grouped state while the other is in mature state.

record.NAME: k_pt_path_change_one_grouped_one_creation
record.DESCRIPTION: Hysteresis for the confidence value which is applied additive when a path change shall be applied to a given object. This hysteresis is used when one path is in grouped state while the other is in creation state.

record.NAME: k_pt_kill_path_exceed_dist_thres
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the threshold of the position of the zero reference point to kill 3rd 4th lane path in vcs.

record.NAME: k_pt_kill_path_max_diff_posn
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the max differential position between [ZERO-1, ZERO+1] to kill 3rd 4th lane path.

record.NAME: k_pt_max_diff_num_path_point
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum difference of path points

record.NAME: k_pt_group_path_min_overlap_count
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum overlap count value to determine if two path matches

record.NAME: k_pt_group_path_min_overlap_count_ad
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum overlap count value to determine if two path perfectly matches

record.NAME: k_pt_find_min_diff_path_points
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum difference of points of the path tha can be used for matching

record.NAME: k_pt_find_max_diff_path_points
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum difference of points between path and left point of object that can be used for matching

record.NAME: k_pt_kill_lane_change_min_diff_path_point
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the min difference of points of the path that can be considered as potential lane change path

record.NAME: k_pt_min_diff_num_path_points
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the min differential path points between two paths for killing the path with lower number of points

record.NAME: k_pt_f_apply_move_point
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the flag to switch on/off function move point based on yawrate and vehicle speed. Default switch off it will have impact on adapt intersection length based on steering angle

record.NAME: k_pt_lower_lim_obj_orient_lat
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the lower heading limit for an object to be classified as laterally moving

record.NAME: k_pt_upper_lim_obj_orient_lat
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the upper heading limit for an object to be classified as laterally moving

record.NAME: k_pt_apply_move_point_min_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the lower speed threshold for applying moving of path points

record.NAME: k_pt_apply_move_point_min_yaw_rate
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the lower yaw rate threshold for applying moving of path points

record.NAME: k_pt_move_point_yaw_rate_thres_calc_ego_shift
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the lower angle threshold for calculation of ego shifting vector by curvature

record.NAME: k_pt_group_paths_min_interval_dist
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum difference distance between two path points to be considered as crossing paths

record.NAME: k_pt_path_track_long_range_limit
record.DESCRIPTION: Indicates the maximum longitudinal distance for objects to be used for tracking paths.

record.NAME: k_pt_path_track_lat_range_limit
record.DESCRIPTION: Indicates the maximum lateral distance for objects to be used for tracking paths.

record.NAME: k_pt_min_path_length_proc_lane_change
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum number of path points to to apply processing of path points for lane change paths

record.NAME: k_pt_group_overlap_paths_min_diff
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum distance between two paths at the the same grid point for path overlapping

record.NAME: k_pt_en_algo_min_vel_inactive
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the minimum ego velocity to enable path algo

record.NAME: k_pt_en_algo_max_val_active
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the maximum ego velocity to keep path algo active

record.NAME: k_pt_point_diff_grouping_borders_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the borders of grouping so that an weighting factor is chosen accordingly. This applies only to points which are contained in one path only

record.NAME: k_pt_point_diff_weighting_factor_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the borders of grouping so that an weighting factor is chosen accordingly. This applies only to points which are contained in one path only

record.NAME: k_pt_cond_kill_implaus_path
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the difference of number of path points for validity analysis of path

record.NAME: k_pt_default_range_of_tracking_zone
record.DESCRIPTION: indicates the default absolute maximum lateral distance which can be displayed by the grid point array

record.NAME: k_pt_min_exist_prob_to_be_valid
record.DESCRIPTION: minimum existence probability an object needs to have in order for it to be considered for path tracking.

record.NAME: k_pt_min_path_length_after_rot
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the minimum path length which is needed for paths after rotation to be valid enough for objects being matched to them.

record.NAME: k_pt_dist_obj_to_border_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for distance between object and path border metric. This lists the values of the metric

record.NAME: k_pt_dist_obj_to_border_conf_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for distance between object and path border metric. This lists the confidence values

record.NAME: k_pt_dist_border_to_isect_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for distance between path border and intersection with coordinate axis metric. This lists the values of the metric

record.NAME: k_pt_dist_border_to_isect_conf_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for distance between path border and intersection with coordinate axis metric. This lists the confidence values

record.NAME: k_pt_dist_obj_to_path_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for distance between object to next path point metric. This lists the values of the metric

record.NAME: k_pt_dist_obj_to_path_conf_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for distance between object to next path point metric. This lists the confidence values

record.NAME: k_pt_similarity_trail_path_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for similarity of left path points by object and path pair candidate metric. This lists the values of the metric

record.NAME: k_pt_similarity_trail_path_conf_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Used for calculation of confidence of a path object pair for similarity of left path points by object and path pair candidate metric. This lists the values of the metric

record.NAME: k_pt_weight_of_last_trail_point
record.DESCRIPTION: Weight for the last created point of the path to which the object is associated to. Used for similarity calculation of a path

record.NAME: k_pt_weight_of_sec_last_trail_point
record.DESCRIPTION: Weight for the second last created point of the path to which the object is associated to. Used for similarity calculation of a path

record.NAME: k_pt_heading_diff_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the heading difference between path heading and tracker heading in rad

record.NAME: k_pt_heading_diff_conf_lut
record.DESCRIPTION: Describes the confidence of heading difference between path heading and tracker heading.

record.NAME: k_pt_weight_heading_diff_confidence
record.DESCRIPTION: Since three heading differences are calculated in total, the actual heading difference where the object is located shall be weighted stronger than the next headings.

record.NAME: k_pt_min_confidence_valid_match
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold for the confidence in order for the path to be a valid match to an object

record.NAME: k_pt_dist_betw_paths_similarity_matching
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold of difference of distances between object and path and also for host an path. When two paths are similar, the nearer path to the host shall be used as match.

record.NAME: k_pt_min_path_length_obj_trail
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum path length of the created object trail for further comparison in matching

record.NAME: k_pt_f_check_object_age_plausibility
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to enable or disable the object age plausibility check.

record.NAME: k_pt_range_nearest_border_impl_path
record.DESCRIPTION: Index range between host and nearest path border to the host.

record.NAME: k_pt_host_implausibilty_range
record.DESCRIPTION: Offset which is applied to the host dimensions such that when a path point of a extrapolated path is contained in the extrapolation process, the path is invalidated.

record.NAME: k_pt_start_of_lane_change_processing
record.DESCRIPTION: Start from which grid points will be used for lane change processing.

record.NAME: k_pt_end_of_lane_change_processing
record.DESCRIPTION: End until which grid points will be used for lane change processing.

record.NAME: k_pt_trail_max_speed_trail_to_path_conv
record.DESCRIPTION: Speed based criteria for conversion of trail to path information. If the host speed is lower than the threshold, the trail information can be converted to trail information.

record.NAME: k_pt_minimum_host_trail_length
record.DESCRIPTION: criteria for length of the host trail. Only if the length of the trail is exceeding the threshold, a path shall be created based on the trail.

record.NAME: k_pt_enable_host_trail
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to enable or disable creation of host trails used for host path generation.

record.NAME: k_pt_max_heading_diff_valid_interval
record.DESCRIPTION: Threshold indicating the maximum allowed heading difference for an interval to be used for path creation.

record.NAME: k_pt_minimum_amount_of_trail_points
record.DESCRIPTION: Amount of minimum needed points for path creation based on trail information.
